# Telegram, Twitch and Facebook Live

## Telegram channels and groups

**Public action:** use an operator-provided official HTTPS invitation. A public channel can use https://t.me/{username}?livestream or the invite generated by Telegram, including its invite hash where required. Preserve the returned invite verbatim after validating the approved host and syntax. For private channels use the authorized invite only on a correctly restricted view. Display “Watch on Telegram” with an ordinary navigable link so the OS can open the installed app or the provider landing page. Do not substitute the channel home, a public-post widget, a guessed stream URL or an ingest key. Telegram's public web widgets describe posts. A documented anonymous live player for the church page was not found.

**Calendar automation is possible, but its authentication matters.** Telegram's MTProto phone methods are for an authorized user with the necessary channel/group admin rights. A Bot API token alone cannot create the scheduled group call or get its RTMP credentials. Offer a link-only connection by default. For churches opting into account-backed scheduling, clearly disclose the scope of a retained Telegram user session and support disconnect/revocation. Protect api_id/api_hash, user session and two-step verification exchange. Never solicit a login code in public settings. An announcement bot is a separate optional integration.

| Operation | MTProto contract and UI effect |
| --- | --- |
| Schedule | phone.createGroupCall with peer, unique persistent random_id, title, schedule_date (Unix time) and rtmp_stream flag for an external encoder. One remote call is a specific Telegram session. Materialize weekly services locally. Queue creation until the documented window, 10 seconds to 8 days ahead, and respect limits on concurrent calls in the same chat. |
| Adopt | Resolve correct peer and current/scheduled call using Telegram's group call information. Store peer and call identity/access metadata securely. Admin approves binding to a local occurrence. Guest accounts and similarly named channels are never sufficient. |
| Invite | phone.exportGroupCallInvite returns the authorized invite. Choose listener access for a public watch button. Never distribute a presenter-capable link accidentally. |
| Start | phone.startScheduledGroupCall explicitly starts a scheduled session. A countdown alone must not start the broadcast. Recording/active state and scheduled state are distinct. A public link that resolves does not prove live. |
| Encoder | phone.getGroupCallStreamRtmpUrl returns ingest URL/key for a permitted broadcaster. The revoke option rotates the key. Show only by explicit authorized action. Neither value is a public player URL. |
| Edit/cancel | phone.editGroupCallTitle handles title. Check specifically supported timing edits. If the remote call cannot be moved equivalently, tell the editor, retain the mapping and offer explicit cancellation/recreation with new invite. phone.discardGroupCall ends a call and is destructive. |
| Recording | phone.toggleGroupCallRecord starts/stops authorized recording. The result is delivered to the initiating account's Saved Messages. Offer church-owned original upload or explicit, authorized media import. Receiving a bot notification is not authority to read a user's Saved Messages. |
| Recovery | FLOOD_WAIT defers for the indicated interval. Revoked admin rights or user session disables only Telegram writes. Never publish a private invite as an automatic fallback. |

Acceptance: link works on mobile and desktop, logged-out visitors get an honest provider handoff, no Telegram script loads on the church site before interaction, a Wednesday schedule is programmed once with duplicate requests suppressed, and a church with only a bot token sees local scheduling plus manual invitation.

References include [deep links](https://core.telegram.org/api/links), [widgets](https://core.telegram.org/widgets), [group calls](https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls), [create scheduled call](https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.createGroupCall), [start scheduled call](https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.startScheduledGroupCall), [export invite](https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.exportGroupCallInvite), [RTMP credentials](https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.getGroupCallStreamRtmpUrl), [recording](https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.toggleGroupCallRecord).

## Twitch

Store broadcaster user ID as identity and channel login as the current embed label. Use the official channel player with the required parent hostname(s), HTTPS and minimum dimensions. Include the site's actual custom domain and preview host if permitted. A VOD replay uses the video ID and the embed's video parameter. A permitted watch-page link is always available. Respect platform player controls, ads and playback policies. Private Joomla membership does not privatize a public Twitch channel.

Connect registered Twitch client ID plus appropriate OAuth grant. Server API requests need Client-Id and Bearer authorization. Validate token, identity and required scopes. Read current stream using Helix GET /streams with user_id. For event-driven status subscribe to stream.online and stream.offline. Receive EventSub verification challenge, notifications and revocations. Verify Twitch's HMAC over message ID, timestamp and raw body, reject stale messages, and bind subscription condition to the mapped broadcaster. Resolve old offline events against current live start/ID.

Import via GET /helix/schedule?broadcaster_id=… and follow its pagination cursor. Manage segments with POST/PATCH/DELETE /helix/schedule/segment using channel:manage:schedule and the matching broadcaster. Use start_time, timezone, duration in minutes, title and is_recurring. Twitch limits nonrecurring segments to qualifying accounts (Partners/Affiliates). Editing title, category, duration or timezone of a recurring segment can change the entire series. Show a scope preview. A Joomla one-off exception must not update every Twitch occurrence inadvertently. The remote schedule is a guide to audiences, not proof of a live feed.

Get Videos for the broadcaster after the stream ends. Adopt a VOD by stream identity where returned. VOD storage and expiry depend on the channel's settings and plan. A watch URL is not a downloadable export. Permit an authorized owner to upload the original/download from Twitch Video Producer. Never substitute clip creation for full-service archiving. Test a renamed channel, missing parent hostname, revoked subscription, an affiliate-only action rejected for this account, and a live stream with no saved past broadcast.

References include [embeds](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/embed/video-and-clips/), [broadcast schedules](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/schedule), [schedule methods](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/reference/schedule), [stream API](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/api/reference/streams), [EventSub verification](https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/eventsub/handling-webhook-events), [Video Producer/VOD](https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/video-on-demand?language=en_US).

## Facebook Live

Adopt a public Facebook video permalink or authorized Page live-video ID. Render the official public video plugin when the video supports embedding, with canonical page link as fallback. Group/private broadcasts may require login or membership and need an external action. Never expose a Page publishing token, a moderator link, or stream_url as the public action. A disabled network/provider should produce the church-configured alternate immediately.

For Page-managed automation use a versioned Graph API app, Page access token and an administrator-authorized Page. Verify permissions for the particular endpoint and current app mode/review. Creation is POST /{page-id}/live_videos. Store the returned LiveVideo ID and permalink, separating publishing/ingest data. Use the applicable SCHEDULED_UNPUBLISHED/SCHEDULED_LIVE state and documented time fields for that API version (the Page reference includes event_params.start_time for Live Online Events). Read back the actual schedule. Enable remote time editing only when the selected API version, Page and event type round-trip it. Map per occurrence, import and normalize provider state. Never infer it from the public Page URL. Cancellation/ending a live event is a distinct owner action.

Public event creation may be unavailable due to age/follower thresholds, missing permissions, an expired token or Page restrictions. Keep the manual link working and expose provider diagnostics to the church admin. Meta announced a 30-day retention window for new Facebook Live videos starting February 2025. Prompt an authorized owner to download/transfer the recording within the applicable window or use the local encoder master. Do not promise an arbitrary private Group download API.

References include [official embedded live video player](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/plugins/embedded-video-player/), [Page live videos](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/reference/page/live_videos/), [Meta storage policy](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/updating-our-facebook-live-video-storage-policy/).
